name: Oficina - Operacao (__AMBIENTE__)
description: Ordens de servico, APIs, Kubernetes e saude da oficina. Gerado por docs/newrelic/importar.sh

widgets.title: Volume diario de ordens de servico (por loja)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM OrdemServicoEvento WHERE evento = 'criada' AND appName = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__' FACET lojaId SINCE 30 days ago TIMESERIES 1 day
SELECT count(*) AS 'OS abertas' FROM OrdemServicoEvento WHERE evento = 'criada' AND appName = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__' SINCE today COMPARE WITH 1 day ago

widgets.title: Tempo medio por status (minutos): Diagnostico, Execucao, Finalizacao

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(minutosNoStatusAnterior) AS 'minutos' FROM OrdemServicoEvento WHERE evento = 'status_alterado' AND appName = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__' AND statusAnterior IN ('EmDiagnostico', 'EmExecucao', 'Finalizada') FACET statusAnterior SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM OrdemServicoEvento WHERE evento = 'status_alterado' AND appName = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__' FACET status SINCE 1 day ago TIMESERIES 1 hour

widgets.title: Falhas inesperadas no processamento de OS

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM OrdemServicoEvento WHERE evento = 'falha' AND inesperada IS true AND appName = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__' FACET operacao, erro SINCE 1 day ago TIMESERIES

widgets.title: Erros e falhas nas integracoes (banco, SNS, demais)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__' FACET error.class, transactionName SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Latencia por endpoint (p50 / p95 / p99, ms)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(duration * 1000, 50, 95, 99) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__' SINCE 1 hour ago TIMESERIES
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'erro %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__' SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT percentile(duration * 1000, 95) AS 'p95 ms' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__' FACET name SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 10
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__' SINCE 1 hour ago TIMESERIES
SELECT timestamp, level, message, context.CorrelationId FROM Log WHERE entity.name = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__' AND level IN ('ERROR', 'Error', 'WARN', 'Warning') SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50
SELECT average(cpuUsedCores) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'oficina-__AMBIENTE__-eks' AND namespaceName = 'oficina' AND containerName = 'api' FACET podName SINCE 1 hour ago TIMESERIES

SELECT average(memoryWorkingSetBytes) / 1e6 FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'oficina-__AMBIENTE__-eks' AND namespaceName = 'oficina' AND containerName = 'api' FACET podName SINCE 1 hour ago TIMESERIES

SELECT latest(currentReplicas) AS 'atuais', latest(desiredReplicas) AS 'desejadas' FROM K8sHpaSample WHERE clusterName = 'oficina-__AMBIENTE__-eks' AND namespaceName = 'oficina' SINCE 1 hour ago TIMESERIES
SELECT uniqueCount(nodeName) AS 'nos' FROM K8sNodeSample WHERE clusterName = 'oficina-__AMBIENTE__-eks' SINCE 1 hour ago TIMESERIES
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE result = 'SUCCESS') AS 'uptime %' FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE monitorName = 'oficina-health-__AMBIENTE__' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT latest(isReady) AS 'pronto', latest(status) FROM K8sPodSample WHERE clusterName = 'oficina-__AMBIENTE__-eks' AND namespaceName = 'oficina' FACET podName SINCE 30 minutes ago
SELECT sum(restartCountDelta) AS 'reinicios' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'oficina-__AMBIENTE__-eks' AND namespaceName = 'oficina' SINCE 1 day ago
